metadata.title: Antik Surf Club | Asilah, Morocco
metadata.description: Surf lessons, surf trips and unforgettable experiences in Asilah, Morocco.

surfLessons.title: Surf Lessons
surfLessons.description: Our surf lessons are designed for all levels, from beginners to experienced surfers. Each session includes theory, in-water practice, and personalized corrections.

lesson1.title: SURFING LESSONS (2 HOURS)
lesson1.content7: Lessons longer than 7 days need to be consulted.

lesson3.title: WATER PHOTOGRAPHY SERVICE
lesson3.content1: Take the best memories of your experience

rentals.title: Surfboard Rentals
rentals.description: We offer a wide range of surfboards for rent, suitable for all skill levels. Our rental service includes high-quality boards, wetsuits, and accessories to ensure you have the best surfing experience.
